name: loom-escape
description: Stimulate looming detectors (LC4 + LPLC2). The fly should run away within ~100 ms (escape race).
rationale: LC4 and LPLC2 are the canonical looming detectors. Their spike drives the escape pathway through the giant fiber (GF) which is electrically boosted by ×6 (see Sim.swift tuning gotchas). Abrupt stim, not a ramp — the ~1200-synapse feedforward inhibition is delayed 4 ms and loses to the electrical drive only on fast onset.
